challenge.results: The ordinary-let example gives 35 by evaluating the second initializer under outer bindings. Its let* counterpart gives 70 with the earlier inner binding visible. The clauses independently state unspecified initializer order for let and a left-to-right sequence for let*.

limitations: This covers ordinary binding-list forms. Named let and recursive and multiple-value bindings each have their own rules.
